item.text:
{
  "title": "Isolette Monitor — Detect Monitor Failure",
  "system_description": "The Detect Monitor Failure component identifies internal failures in the Monitor Temperature Function, with a memory check failure given as an example. It supplies a Boolean failure indication through an internal_failure output. The implementation comprises a process containing a periodic thread; the process forwards the thread output. The surrounding monitor connects this indication to its mode manager. No monitored input ports or failure-detection mechanism are defined for this component. These are draft derived requirements for source lines 401–431; process structure and scheduling are source-defined implementation choices.",
  "requirements": [
    {
      "id": "DMF-001",
      "statement": "The Detect Monitor Failure function shall identify internal failures in the Monitor Temperature Function.",
      "category": "functional",
      "source_start": 402,
      "source_end": 403,
      "evidence_quote": "The Detect Monitor Failure Function identifies internal failures, (e.g., a memory check failure)"
    },
    {
      "id": "DMF-002",
      "statement": "The Detect Monitor Failure function shall define a single Boolean-valued internal variable named Monitor Internal Failure.",
      "category": "state",
      "source_start": 403,
      "source_end": 404,
      "evidence_quote": "It defines a single Boolean-valued internal variable,"
    },
    {
      "id": "DMF-003",
      "statement": "When an internal failure is detected, the Detect Monitor Failure function shall set Monitor Internal Failure to True.",
      "category": "functional",
      "source_start": 404,
      "source_end": 404,
      "evidence_quote": "Monitor Internal Failure, which is set to True if an internal failure is detected."
    },
    {
      "id": "DMF-004",
      "statement": "The implementation shall define Detect_Monitor_Failure_Process_i as a process.",
      "category": "architecture",
      "source_start": 409,
      "source_end": 409,
      "evidence_quote": "part def Detect_Monitor_Failure_Process_i :> Process"
    },
    {
      "id": "DMF-005",
      "statement": "The Detect_Monitor_Failure_Process_i process shall contain a part named dmf of type Detect_Monitor_Failure_i.",
      "category": "architecture",
      "source_start": 411,
      "source_end": 411,
      "evidence_quote": "part dmf: Detect_Monitor_Failure_i;"
    },
    {
      "id": "DMF-006",
      "statement": "The Detect_Monitor_Failure_Process_i process shall expose an output data port named internal_failure of type Isolette_Data_Model::Failure_Flag_i.",
      "category": "interface",
      "source_start": 413,
      "source_end": 413,
      "evidence_quote": "out port internal_failure : DataPort { :>> type : Isolette_Data_Model::Failure_Flag_i; }"
    },
    {
      "id": "DMF-007",
      "statement": "The Detect_Monitor_Failure_Process_i process shall connect the dmf thread's internal_failure output to its own internal_failure output through the port connection named dmf_if.",
      "category": "architecture",
      "source_start": 415,
      "source_end": 416,
      "evidence_quote": "connect dmf.internal_failure to internal_failure;"
    },
    {
      "id": "DMF-008",
      "statement": "The Detect_Monitor_Failure_Process_i process shall have CASE_Scheduling scheduling domain 10.",
      "category": "architecture",
      "source_start": 418,
      "source_end": 418,
      "evidence_quote": "attribute Domain: CASE_Scheduling::Domain = 10;"
    },
    {
      "id": "DMF-009",
      "statement": "The implementation shall define Detect_Monitor_Failure_i as a thread.",
      "category": "architecture",
      "source_start": 421,
      "source_end": 421,
      "evidence_quote": "part def Detect_Monitor_Failure_i :> Thread"
    },
    {
      "id": "DMF-010",
      "statement": "The Detect_Monitor_Failure_i thread shall use periodic dispatch.",
      "category": "timing",
      "source_start": 423,
      "source_end": 423,
      "evidence_quote": "attribute :>> Dispatch_Protocol = Supported_Dispatch_Protocols::Periodic;"
    },
    {
      "id": "DMF-011",
      "statement": "The Detect_Monitor_Failure_i thread shall have a period of 1000 milliseconds.",
      "category": "timing",
      "source_start": 424,
      "source_end": 424,
      "evidence_quote": "attribute :>> Period = 1000 [ms];"
    },
    {
      "id": "DMF-012",
      "statement": "The Detect_Monitor_Failure_i thread shall have CASE_Scheduling scheduling domain 10.",
      "category": "architecture",
      "source_start": 425,
      "source_end": 425,
      "evidence_quote": "attribute Domain: CASE_Scheduling::Domain = 10;"
    },
    {
      "id": "DMF-013",
      "statement": "The Detect_Monitor_Failure_i thread shall expose an output data port named internal_failure of type Isolette_Data_Model::Failure_Flag_i.",
      "category": "interface",
      "source_start": 427,
      "source_end": 427,
      "evidence_quote": "out port internal_failure : DataPort { :>> type : Isolette_Data_Model::Failure_Flag_i; }"
    }
  ],
  "assumptions": [],
  "unresolved": [
    "The internal failures to be detected, their detection criteria, and the detection mechanism are unspecified; a memory check failure is only an example.",
    "The mapping of the prose variable Monitor Internal Failure to the internal_failure port's flag field is implied but not explicitly defined here; the Failure_Flag_i type definition is absent.",
    "The initial failure indication, behavior when no failure is detected, clearing or latching behavior, and reset or reboot behavior are unspecified.",
    "No mode-dependent behavior is specified for the failure detector.",
    "The 1000-millisecond period does not specify execution time, deadline, detection latency, or output-delivery latency.",
    "Scheduling-domain semantics and data-port communication semantics are not supplied."
  ]
}
